mapper.select: SELECT APPLY_DATA.*, (GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(APPLY_DATA.FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLY_DATA.PERSON_ID, '30') + GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(APPLY_DATA.FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLY_DATA.PERSON_ID, '301')) OT_TOTAIL_MONTH FROM (SELECT HR.LOCAL_NAME, HR.ENGLISH_NAME, HR.EMPID, HR.PERSON_ID, GET_DEPT_NAME(HR.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HR.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) POSITION_NAME, A.APPLY_NO, A.APPLY_TYPE_NO, A.APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(A.APPLY_TYPE_CODE, 'ko') APPLY_TYPE_NAME_KO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(A.APPLY_TYPE_CODE, 'vi') APPLY_TYPE_NAME_VI, A.APPLY_TYPE_NAME, A.APPLY_TIME, A.ORDER_TIME, A.FROM_TIME, A.TO_TIME, A.APPLY_LENGTH, CASE WHEN A.APPLY_TYPE_CODE = '141474' THEN GET_AR_LEAVE_LENGTH(HR.PERSON_ID, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(A.FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(A.TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), '141474') || ' minutes' ELSE CASE WHEN A.APPLY_LENGTH >= AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME) THEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH / AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || CASE WHEN ROUND(A.APPLY_LENGTH / AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN ' days ' ELSE ' day ' END || CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' ELSE NULL END ELSE CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' ELSE '0 hour' END END END ATT_LENGTH, CASE WHEN A.APPLY_LENGTH > 1 THEN A.APPLY_LENGTH || ' hours' ELSE A.APPLY_LENGTH || ' hour' END OT_LENGTH, A.REMARK, A.MISDOCID FROM (SELECT ATT.APPLY_NO, ATT.PERSON_ID, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) APPLY_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(ATT.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, ATT.APPLY_LENGTH, ATT.LEAVE_REASON REMARK, ATT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB ATT WHERE ATT.AFFIRM_FLAG IN ('14014306', '14014307') AND ATT.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ATT.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL AND ATT.APPLY_LENGTH > 0 AND ATT.ACTIVITY = 1 AND ATT.CREATED_BY NOT LIKE '111111%' AND ATT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT OT.APPLY_NO, OT.PERSON_ID, OT.OT_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, OT.OT_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(OT.OT_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) APPLY_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(OT.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(OT.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(OT.OT_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(OT.OT_TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, OT.OT_APPLY_HOUR APPLY_LENGTH, OT.APPLY_OT_REMARK REMARK, OT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT WHERE OT.AFFIRM_FLAG IN ('14014306', '14014307') AND OT.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OT.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND OT.OT_TYPE_NO IS NOT NULL AND OT.OT_APPLY_HOUR > 0 AND OT.ACTIVITY = 1 AND OT.CREATED_BY NOT LIKE '111111%' AND OT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT OTO.APPLY_NO, OTO.PERSON_ID, OTO.OT_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, OTO.OT_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(OTO.OT_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) APPLY_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(OTO.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(OTO.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(OTO.OT_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(OTO.OT_TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, OTO.OT_APPLY_HOUR APPLY_LENGTH, OTO.APPLY_OT_REMARK REMARK, OTO.MISDOCID FROM ESS_APPLY_OT_OVER OTO WHERE OTO.AFFIRM_FLAG IN ('14014306', '14014307') AND OTO.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OTO.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND OTO.OT_TYPE_NO IS NOT NULL AND OTO.OT_APPLY_HOUR > 0 AND OTO.ACTIVITY = 1 AND OTO.CREATED_BY NOT LIKE '111111%' AND OTO.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT CARD.APPLY_NO, CARD.PERSON_ID, '218197' APPLY_TYPE_NO, CARD.ITEM_NO APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(CARD.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) APPLY_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(CARD.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(CARD.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(CARD.IN_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(CARD.OUT_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, CASE WHEN ROUND((CARD.OUT_TIME - CARD.IN_TIME) * 24, 2) > 6 THEN ROUND((CARD.OUT_TIME - CARD.IN_TIME) * 24, 2) - 1 ELSE ROUND((CARD.OUT_TIME - CARD.IN_TIME) * 24, 2) END APPLY_LENGTH, CARD.APPLY_REASON REMARK, CARD.MISDOCID FROM ESS_CARD_APPLY_TB CARD WHERE CARD.AFFIRM_FLAG IN ('14014306', '14014307') AND CARD.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CARD.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND CARD.ITEM_NO IS NOT NULL AND CARD.ACTIVITY = '1' AND CARD.CREATED_BY NOT LIKE '111111%' AND CARD.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT TR.APPLY_NO, TR.PERSON_ID, '81006456' APPLY_TYPE_NO, TR.TRAINING_TYPE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(TR.TRAINING_TYPE, 'vi') APPLY_TYPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(TR.START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(TR.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(TR.CREATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(TR.UPDATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, TR.ACTIVITY APPLY_LENGTH, TR.REMARK REMARK, TR.MISDOCID FROM EDU_TRAINING_REGISTER TR WHERE TR.AFFIRM_FLAG IN ('14014306', '14014307') AND TR.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND TR.ACTIVITY = 1 AND TR.CREATED_BY NOT LIKE '111111%' AND TR.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0) A, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE A.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND A.PERSON_ID NOT LIKE '111111%' AND HR.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) APPLY_DATA ORDER BY APPLY_DATA.ORDER_TIME

SELECT S.SEQ, S.AFFIRM_TYPE, DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE, 4, 0, 1) ASSIGN_TYPE, NULL RECEIVER_TYPE, E.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.AFFIRM_TYPE <> 3 AND S.AFFIRM_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT S.SEQ, S.AFFIRM_TYPE, NULL ASSIGN_TYPE, DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE, 3, 'referer', 'receiver') RECEIVER_TYPE, E.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.AFFIRM_TYPE IN (3, 4) ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL
